out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: ASSEMBLING CAKE SHEETS.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HAND BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES WHEN HANDLING READY TO EAT FOODS. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES CONTINUED TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE WASHED, RINSED AND HANG DOUGH WHISKS TO DRY WITHOUT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO RETURN DOUGH WHISK TO SANITIZER SOLUTION FOR 30-60 SECONDS BEFORE HANGING TO AIR DRY. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over UTENSILS, SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AND SMALL COUNTER AT END OF HAND WASH SINK NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO RELOCATE DEVICE AND EMAIL EHS TO VERIFY COMPLIANCE WITHIN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. OBSERVED GAS AND ELECTRIC OVENS RELOCATED FROM KITCHEN OF CHATEAU DE CHANTILLY AND INSTALLED IN KITCHEN OF “CHATEAU KITCHEN” WITHOUT SUBMISSION OF AMENDMENT AND PLANS FOR MODIFICATIONS COMPLETED TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT FOR APPROVAL.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: PLEASE SUBMIT AMENDMENT AND PLANS FOR MODIFICATIONS COMPLETED ALONG WITH UPDATED EQUIPMENT LISTING INTO PLUS ACCOUNT FOR REVIEW AND APPROVAL WITHIN 10 DAYS.
